webui.openapi.docs.title: API Docs
webui.openapi.docs.description: Interactive reference of the public HTTP contract generated from the module code-first declarations.
webui.openapi.docs.legend.title: About this reference
webui.openapi.docs.legend.detail: Operations use the project security profiles: bearerAuth accepts an HTTP bearer token entered via Authorize; webuiSession operations depend on the browser session cookie and CSRF-bound mutations, so their write operations cannot be executed from this reference. In mock demo builds there is no backend, so request execution is unavailable.
webui.openapi.docs.unavailable: The API contract snapshot is unavailable.
